candidate_evidence.quote: individualized cancer stem cell targeted therapy based on high-throughput functional profiling of FDA/EMA-approved drugs

role_evidence.quote: A personalized drug combination will be prescribed to each patient based on the functional drug screen

agents.drug_class_hint: FDA/EMA-approved drugs selected per patient by ex vivo high-throughput functional drug screen of autologous cancer stem cells

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 record. No drugs are named; coded as unspecified approved-drug panel (C13). Functional ex vivo drug screening is not a molecular tumour biomarker.
